title: Focused launcher recognition refuses `node --test --test-force-exit <file>` (the gate's own helper-test shape) as an unsupported form
outcome: A focused launcher run of a Node test file with the same flags the gate's helper-test stage uses (--test --test-force-exit, optionally a reporter or a name pattern) is recognized and recorded as a Test check like other node --test forms.
acceptance: The holder's note identifies, with file:line, which recognition rule rejects `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- node --test --test-force-exit scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs` as unsupported, and which node --test flags are accepted today.

The focused Node grammar accepts bare --test-force-exit before test files, including the maintained gate's exact helperTestArgs shape and combinations with already supported options. Matched launcher artifacts still determine native pass/fail/unknown counts and exit; source/grant, ownership, argument-identity and artifact-validation fences remain intact. Regression checks cover recognition and recorded outcomes, reject valued or misplaced --test-force-exit and unsupported watch/reporter forms, and verify refusal feedback includes the offending flag.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Focused Node grammar now recognizes the gate’s bare --test-force-exit helper-test shape and records outcomes with preserved refusal and artifact fences. The fresh independent acceptance evaluation passed all 3 criteria; the full gate and focused run passed at the evaluated source revision.
